prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was thinking about that work trip back in 2025—ended up bouncing between Beijing and Shanghai, and it felt like the whole week was just trains and airports.
Shanghai itself was great though—everyone kept talking about where to stay in the city, like it’s a whole topic on its own.
My friend was the one who handled the flight stuff, and I remember the ticket was for 2025-03-25—honestly I didn’t even see the details until later.
After the fact I noticed it was Air China, flight CA1234, and it was booked under Zhang Wei—so yeah, definitely not my doing.
And for the hotel, we stayed at Hyatt on the Bund—check-in was 2025-03-18 for 2 nights, and the reservation name was Zhou Jun.
